notes: Closes the real-interop gap: MAX_CLAIM_BYTES_V1 raised 64->128, digest now computed over the claim's real (witnessed) length via a new sha256_var gadget instead of zero-padded -- see zk-cred-vega's sha256_var.rs module doc. Real, salted ISO 18013-5 IssuerSignedItem claims (79-95+ bytes) now fit and produce a digest matching a real issuer's valueDigests, proven end-to-end against a generated realistic test mdoc (test-vectors/mdl_4claims_mixed_disclosure.json). Supersedes vega-mc-p256-v1-verifier-key-r4 (deprecated). Still unpublished -- sha256_var is genuinely novel circuit code and has not had an independent security review yet. | deprecated: Superseded by r6: variable-width digestID interop (mso_splice/onehot_cursor) + digest_id_extract binding closes the digestID-to-claim-bytes cross-check gap. See sirosfoundation/zk-cred-vega commits ef9fc55/f86d71d.
